setups.name: ATH Magnet
setups.desc: Leader within reach of its all-time high: momentum and attention pulling it through.

setups.name: Leader Pullback
setups.desc: Leader back at its 21 EMA, uptrend intact, sellers drying up: buy the dip, not the chase.

setups.name: Rotation Rookie
setups.desc: A theme or sub-theme money is newly moving into; the stock hasn't run yet.

setups.name: Qullamaggie Flag
setups.desc: High-ADR top performer basing in a tight flag after a big leg (any theme). Buy the flag break, stop low of day, hold 3-5 days, trail the 10 EMA.

setups.name: Round Number Magnet
setups.desc: Strong stock a short hop under a big round number ($50, $100, $200...): the level draws price in, and a clean break above it often runs.

setups.name: Minervini VCP
setups.desc: Young Stage 2 trend tightening up with volume drying out. Buy the pivot break, stop under the last contraction (max 8%), hold while above the 50-day.

setups.name: Box Retest
setups.desc: Broke out of a box or a multi-touch range, snapped back to the old top and just bounced off it, in a strong group (sub-theme above its 50-day or top-20% sub-theme/theme). Buy, stop under the retest low, target = box height above the top. Paid best right after a breadth thrust.

setups.name: Box Spring
setups.desc: Broke below a box or a multi-touch support, failed, and just closed back inside the box (a spring / bear trap), in a strong group. Buy, stop 0.5 ADR under the old bottom, target the top of the box. Paid best right after a breadth thrust and in washed-out tapes; in-vogue themes add more.

states.name: Breakout
states.desc: Closed above the black box (prior 10-week high) on 1.2× normal volume, stacked 9 > 21 > 50.

states.name: Pop
states.desc: Nuzzled into the 9/21 WEMA last week and popped back over that week's high: Adam's entry.

states.name: Nuzzling (buy zone)
states.desc: Pulled into the 9 WEMA this week, holding the 21. Buy a pop over this week's high; stop under this week's low.

states.name: Riding the 9/21
states.desc: Stacked and rising, close to the EMAs. Wait for it to nuzzle in.

states.name: Extended
states.desc: More than 1.5 weekly ATRs above the 9 WEMA. Don't chase; wait for the nuzzle.

states.name: In the box
states.desc: Prime positioned and not in a later state yet: holding over the 50 WEMA after the pumps, 9 curling over a rising 21.

prime.name: Prime positioned

points.name: Group leading

points.name: RS line rising
points.desc: RS line (price ÷ SPY) up 15%+ over 13 weeks.

points.name: Gap day
points.desc: A 6%+ gap-up day in the last 13 weeks (earnings or news put it in play).

plan.summary: Nothing new is proven this week. Last week's top item (the Spring) is built and in the playbook, and the FINRA hidden-buying gauge is live as information. The forward log has only one settled day, so the news agents can't be judged until late November. The Top 2 picks started weak (9 closed, -1.7% with stops vs -0.7% without), so the single best next step is a cheap test: replay the picks over 18 months with different stops to see whether the 1-ADR stop is costing money.

items.title: Test the Top 2 stop rule on 18 months of replayed picks
items.where: exit rule for the Top 2 picks: ledger.py stop, trade_bt.pick_replay
items.how: 5 of the first 9 live picks were stopped out and the no-stop result beat the stopped one. Replay every #1/#2 pick (with today's context re-rank) under: no stop, 1 ADR (now), 1.5 ADR, entry-day low, and close-only stops. Pick the rule only if it wins clearly; otherwise keep 1 ADR.
items.test: pick_replay from Mar 2025: next-session entry, 5-session exit, result in % and in R. Compare each stop vs the current 1-ADR stop per date, both halves same sign, t = 2 over 20+ dates; also check the worst trade and the max drawdown so a wider stop isn't just hiding risk.
items.kill: No rule beats 1 ADR in both halves, or the gain comes with much bigger worst-case losses.

items.title: Market filters on setups: volume tilt and hidden buying
items.where: playbook_state modifier (Focus - Selective on bad days); layers volume_tilt, hidden_buying
items.how: Both gauges predict SPY's next month (tilt: low outside thrusts -4.2%; FINRA S&P short share top fifth +3.1% vs +0.7%). Carried over from last week, still untested: do they change the R of OUR setups? One capture run tests both. If yes, the playbook drops every setup a notch on 'Buyers tiring' / low-hidden-buying days.
items.test: tools/picks_context/capture.py signals (5,400+), actionable 5-session result by tilt tier and by FINRA dev fifth, averaged per date, both halves, t = 2 over 20+ dates; repeat inside mixed breadth only so it isn't just the breadth regime again.
items.kill: |t| 2, halves disagree, or the effect disappears inside one breadth regime.

items.title: 'The trade' as a pick context: favour names in the winning groups when winners hold up
items.how: The 'holds up' reading is the closest thing to a pass in new research (+1.1% vs avg group, t 2.0, halves +1.3/+1.1) and the two-camps study found the same thing at the stock level (RS 90 in the winning camp +2.7% vs -5.1% when leaders sit there). Test +1 context for candidates in the winning fifth while the trade 'holds up', and -1 for the winning fifth when it 'gives back'. Two-camps is a duplicate of the_trade for building purposes; fold it in here instead of a separate tile.
items.test: Same capture signals: candidates in winning-fifth groups vs others, split by holds-up / gives-back, 5-session actionable result, per date, both halves, t = 2; then the Top 2 replay with vs without the extra context (must beat the current +1.96%/pick).
items.kill: No edge at the setup level, or it only repeats the existing ignition / leading-and-accelerating context.

items.title: In-vogue groups as long confluence for all setups
items.where: Decision-Card group layer / conviction tag on Trade Setups rows
items.how: A 6-month top-20% theme helped box longs (retest +0.22R, spring +0.45R) but has only been tested on box trades. Test it on ATH Magnet, Pullback, Rotation Rookie, Round Number, Q-Flag and VCP; if it passes, add an 'in vogue' tag that counts.
items.test: Capture signals, in vogue (6-month top-20% theme or sub-theme, as of the signal date) vs not, per setup and pooled, per date, both halves, t = 2.
items.kill: Pooled edge |t| 2 or halves disagree: keep it on box trades only.

items.title: Position ideas list: leaders in leading groups + SoW prime, 50-EMA exit, size by ADR
items.where: new list on Setups / Trade Setups (separate from the 5-day Top 2); layers position_exits, position_sizing, sow
items.how: Still the biggest unbuilt idea: top 2 by Leaders score in leading-and-accelerating sub-themes, optionally requiring SoW 'prime' or 'pop', held up to 3 months with a close-below-50-EMA exit and a size note. Its own forward log.
items.test: Exact dashboard RS/rotation/SoW code, non-overlapping monthly starts, next-open entry, vs SPY and vs other RS 70+ stocks, both halves. Only ~1 year is testable, so it can at most become information until longer history exists.
items.kill: Second half still negative vs SPY, or no better than any RS 70+ stock (the SoW pop already only beat them by +1.6%, t 1.0).

items.title: Agent layers: keep logging, first real read in late November
items.where: catalyst, calendar, macro_brief, trade_stories (forward log / story scorecard)
items.how: Nothing to build. Only Oct 15 has settled (before the agents started); the first agent-researched rows settle next week. Trade Stories is scored every day by its own price check.
items.test: Forward log: real catalyst vs none, red flag vs none, earnings in hold vs not, brief risk; t = 2 over 20+ dates, same sign both halves. Stories: favoured minus hurt groups next 5 sessions.
items.kill: No agent layer reaches |t| = 1 by ~100 settled ideas: cut the catalyst agent to earnings checks only.

items.kill: If Oct 15 works like a normal thrust, demote the 'unconfirmed' wording to a footnote.

review.summary: Still too early to judge the agent layers: only one day of ideas (Oct 15, 24 ideas) has settled, and that day was carded before the catalyst and macro agents started, so news, red flags, earnings and macro-brief risk have no forward results yet. The macro-fit backtest again points the wrong way: recent macro tailwinds came before WORSE setup results than headwinds, so it stays information only. The Top 2 scoreboard is off to a weak start (9 closed picks, avg -1.7% with stops vs +1.4% for the average candidate), but 9 trades is far too few to conclude anything. No ranking changes proposed.
findings: Macro fit (backtest, 6,326 signals Apr 2025-Oct 2026): 5-day tailwind +0.59% (n 1,026) vs headwind +1.99% (n 804), t -1.67, halves -1.1% / -1.1%. Same sign both halves but t 2 - NOT PASSED, info only.
Macro fit 20-day: tailwind +1.38% vs headwind +0.95%, t -0.81, halves -0.9% / -0.1% - not passed. By setup only Round Number Magnet reaches t -2.05 (tailwind worse); not a layer test.
Forward log: 152 ideas carded Oct 15-23 over 7 dates; 24 settled, all from Oct 15 (1 date). Settled ideas +0.2% vs SPY on average (SPY -1.7% that week).
Catalyst, red flags, earnings-in-hold, macro-brief risk: 0 checked rows settled (Oct 15 cards predate the agents) - no evidence yet. First agent-researched rows (Oct 16 cards) settle next week.
More supporting layers (n 3) -0.8% vs fewer (n 9) +5.5% abs; macro tailwind n 10 -1.3%. Single date, far too thin to read.
By role (Oct 15 only): candidates +1.0% vs SPY (n 19), pick1 OSCR -5.4%, pick2 SN +3.1%, watch -4.0% (n 3).
Top 2 scoreboard: 9 closed picks Oct 9-15, 3 winners, avg -1.70% with stops (5 of 9 stopped), -0.70% without stops, vs avg candidate +1.45%. 1 no-fill (ABCL). Too few to judge.

Setup review flag is ON: follow-through Oct 22 (post-thrust playbook: Rotation Rookie +0.34R, Leader Pullback +0.29R, Round Number +0.29R), breadth Weak 3+ sessions, 3 of top 5 themes new since Oct 11.
proposals: No layer changes yet: not enough data. Macro fit did not pass (t -1.67); agent layers have 0 settled checked rows. Revisit when the log has ~60 settled ideas over ~20 dates (around late Nov).
Keep macro fit as information only. Optional research (not a ranking change): test whether a macro HEADWIND is a mean-reversion plus; it is negative in both halves but t -1.67, so it is not proven.

Watch the stop rule: 5 of 9 picks stopped out and the no-stop result (-0.7%) beat the stopped result (-1.7%). Too few trades to change anything; re-check at 30+ closed picks (the replay in trade_bt.pick_replay can test it now if Adam wants).

Act on the existing setup review flag (say 'review my trade setups'): post-thrust playbook after the Oct 22 follow-through, plus Weak breadth and theme rotation since the Oct 11 baseline. Any change needs Adam's approval.

macro_fit.rule: tailwind = macro moves of the last 5 sessions imply > +0.25% for the stock (real sensitivities only); headwind < -0.25%; result = actionable 5-session return of each Trade Setups signal

brief.headline: Fed decision Wednesday plus Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon earnings and Thursday's GDP/core PCE headline a loaded week, with the 10-year near 5% and Brent above $110 on Iran/Houthi risks.
brief.rates: The 10-year Treasury yield is hovering around the 5% mark after September's Fed hike, with markets pricing roughly a 75-80% chance of another hike by December.
brief.oil: Brent is about $114.5 and WTI about $101 on Monday, down roughly 2% on hopes for US-Iran de-escalation via Qatari mediation, but Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities and Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb disruptions keep supply risk high.
brief.fed: The FOMC is expected to hold at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday Oct 28 (statement 2:00 PM, Chair Warsh press conference 2:30 PM ET), with the focus on his tone on a December hike; Daly and Musalem speak Friday.
brief.geo: US-Iran tensions (possible resumption of strikes) and Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure are the active shocks moving oil.
